name: Ashina Yuzuri
source:
Likes: Pleasant things, sweets with mango in them, sea, accessories
Dislikes: Poorness, men who are financially dependent on women, stinky food

A woman who got married and gave birth to her child around the same time as she graduated from school. Her husband works as a full-time employee at a supermarket, while Yuzuri works as a housework agent during day and at her acquaintance's mother's snack bar during night.
